description.text:
The last XY set, released on 2 November 2016 for the 20th anniversary of the card game: a reinvention of Base Set. Its 113 cards, 108 and five secret rares, bring back Base Set's artwork and card layout for Pokémon and Trainers of Base Set, Jungle and the early promos, some reprinted, some changed for the modern game, beside 12 Pokémon-EX, five of them Mega Evolutions such as Mega Charizard-EX, and four Pokémon BREAK, all drawn in the classic style. Its secret rares are old favorites too, among them Flying Pikachu, Surfing Pikachu and Imakuni?'s Doduo.

It drew collectors of the first sets and of the new ones alike and was very popular, though its plain Venusaur and Blastoise were left out.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
Elite Fourum: Set of the Fortnight #10 - XY Evolutions

description.text: The Champion copy of the Evolutions Double Colorless Energy from the Europe International Championships in London, 9 to 11 December 2016, one of the four International Championships of 2017, the first season of these events. The reverse holo card carries the event stamp, plus a "Champion" stamp in the upper left, and went to the winner of each division. Each event had junior, senior and masters divisions in both the card game and the video game, and six Champion copies were handed out at each, 24 in all.
